reason: Asserts that the error from a failed goto carries Playwright Test's async stack, which names this test file; Strider's failures are typed values, and the Vitest integration records no such stack (matrix row property-testerror-stack)
Looking up a frame by its name, `page.frame({ name })`; Strider's frame tree has a `name` field, but no backend reports it, so it is always `None` (the matrix row claims `has`)
Waiting for a popup's opener(), the page that opened it; Strider's Popup reports the popup and its own page, with no link back to the opener
Iterates the own properties of Playwright's client-side page object and asserts nothing about them; Strider's Page is an Effect service with no such object
